messages:
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollout completed: model=redwood/llama-small version=v2026-03-15-weights to canary pool (2 hosts). Release: https://ci.internal/release/462
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty: High error rate observed on canary for /v1/generate. Paging @mira (oncall).
mira (oncall): Paging in. seeing sustained 5xxs and tokenizer exceptions in the canary logs. hitting ~18% errors on canary hosts. Can anyone grab logs and confirm?
eli (sre): grabbing logs now. snippet from canary-01: ```ERROR TokenizerError: unknown token encountered
 at Tokenizer.parse (/srv/serve/tokenizer.js:213)
 at ModelRunner.generate (/srv/serve/runner.py:412)```
eli (sre): Also seeing weight mismatch WARNs earlier in bootstrap: `weightset.namespace mismatch: expected public/v3-tokenized, got public/v3`
zara (eng-runtime): that weightset namespace mismatch is suspicious — release manifest had `weights_namespace: public/v3` instead of the tokenized artifact. Checking release bundle...
zara (eng-runtime): `redwoodctl releases inspect release-462 --format json` shows `artifacts: [weights@public/v3, tokenizer@public/v2]` — tokenizer and weights are from different build runs.
sam (mlops): confirmed. CI pipeline step that pins tokenizer hash failed silently (timeout) and then retried with older cache. We ended up shipping weights built against tokenizer:v2 but the canary runtime pulled tokenizer:v1.4 earlier in the manifest resolution. My bad, that retry logic needs a guard.
mira (oncall): we should kill the canary and rollback to previous stable version. Is there a hot kill-switch?
zara (eng-runtime): yes — flip the feature flag `routing.canary_enabled.redwood/llama-small` to false, and set default route to `v2026-03-10`. Command: ```bash
redwoodctl flag set routing.canary_enabled.redwood/llama-small false --env prod
redwoodctl rollout --model redwood/llama-small --version v2026-03-10 --force
```
mira (oncall): executing now. initiating rollback and kill-switch.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by mira (oncall). Rolling back 2 canaries -> v2026-03-10.
katie (prod-support): FYI CS: customers with elevated error rates: acme-inc, nebulanet, fintrack. Opening a brief customer note: "We observed elevated errors for select API requests; we've rolled back to a previous model version and are monitoring." Will coordinate more if needed. :white_flag:
eli (sre): monitoring metrics: request error rate trending down from 18% -> 2% after first canary switched back (canary-01). tailing logs show tokenizer exceptions gone.
sam (mlops): rolling a short patch to CI now to block retries without hash pin. will push a hotfix job and a gating test that verifies tokenizer+weights hash alignment before release finishes.
zara (eng-runtime): also adding a quick pre-deploy check in the runtime to fail if `weights_namespace` and `tokenizer_namespace` hashes don't match the release manifest mapping. I'll open a PR.
mira (oncall): can we confirm no customer-facing data corruption? any bad completions persisted?
eli (sre): no evidence of persisted bad outputs. this was throwing before generation completed; most requests returned 5xx. No logs of partial outputs stored to vector DBs.
sam (mlops): opening postmortem ticket INC-3421 and ownership. I'll own the postmortem and the CI fix. Action items: (1) CI: block retries that lose artifact pinning, (2) runtime guard for namespace/hash mismatch, (3) rollout dashboard alert for tokenizer mismatch.
katie (prod-support): drafting customer comms for impacted customers, will coordinate with sam for timeline.
mira (oncall): marking incident mitigated — error rates back to baseline across prod and canaries. closing immediate page but keeping an incident channel for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-3421 created: model-variant-mismatch. Severity: P2. Postmortem owner: sam (mlops).
sam (mlops): will post a short RCA and follow-ups within 48h. tagging @zara @eli @katie for action items.
zara (eng-runtime): quick notes for the postmortem: reproduce steps, log snippets, and the manifest diff that caused the mismatch.
mira (oncall): thanks all. filing follow-up: add a canary-livekill runbook entry for model-artifact mismatches.
